facts: Did you hear that? Sound frequency is measured in Hertz (Hz). The higher the Hertz, the higher-pitched the sound. Dogs hear best at 8,000 Hz, while humans hear best at around 2,000 Hz.
Max, Jake, Maggie and Molly are the most popular dog names.
A one year old dog is as physically mature as a 15 year old human.
Dogs have been bred for a variety of purposes, including hunting, guarding, and companionship.
Many foot disorders in dogs are simply an issue of too-long toenails.
